execution: Offline local CPU, cached model. No uploads, paid APIs or credentials.
method: Every nonblank administering and responsible organization name × financial state across both financial snapshots queried. Normalized MiniLM embeddings; cosine top 3 government records and top 3 geographic references within source state. Scores are not probabilities. Existing exact PID checked independently. 2026 government types and 2022-only historical records are retained separately. No new identity/location assignments.
scope_limits: 50 states and DC; no Puerto Rico, Island Areas or tribal-government universe. Independent local governments, dependent school systems and public pension systems are distinct categories. Do not sum multiple vintages or geography layers.
Y functionally active; N dormant, not disincorporated, still counted in the Census inventory.

Directory county may be the most-served area or headquarters county; it is not a full service-area boundary. Place components apply to general-purpose units only. No semantic or directory-component join automatically assigns finance or beneficiary locations.
Census places include governments and statistical CDPs; county subdivisions can be statistical. School/special-district service boundaries and tribal boundaries are not supplied here.
Financial source state constrains retrieval; interstate bodies and ambiguous names can be missed. Similarity neither proves nor disproves identity.
All observed financial name queries were processed; this does not prove every possible government or archived document was found.
New candidates remain review-only; no money duplicated, no new funding attributed, beneficiary geography stays null.
